review.assessment: The change introduces a new file containing only the initial naive implementation, completely failing to implement any of the requested query string enhancements such as repeated key array collection, URL decoding, or edge-case handling.

findings.defect: Repeated keys overwrite previous values instead of collecting them into an array.
No URL decoding is implemented; '+' signs and percent-encoded sequences remain unprocessed.
Bare keys without a value assignment map to undefined instead of an empty string.
Empty input splits into a single empty pair, creating an object with a falsy key and undefined value instead of returning an empty object.
